name: @workerv2/document
description: Worker V2 Document Assembly Platform — the immutable, content-addressable layer that assembles rendered Page Artifacts into a complete, format-INDEPENDENT printable document model. Document aggregate + builder + document manifest + page ordering + print metadata + print settings/profile + assembly config + validation + canonical serialization + sha256 identity + Document Descriptor + a test harness. The bridge between rendering and export. Generates NO PDF, renders NO pages, packages NO print files, performs NO storage/networking, and introduces no business logic; future exporters consume the same immutable Document as independent processors.
